The shared cookie/ad/app selector pack matched 1 cookie element on this page, including the container the rule below targets.

- `#onetrust-consent-sdk` matched 1 element in the live DOM.

Only the public desktop home page was checked. Logged-in views and other routes were not available, and consent choices can change later loads. `recipes/fixtures/booking-com/desktop-real.html` is a sanitized excerpt of the captured live DOM; the legacy synthetic fixtures are not live evidence.
